question: The set of complex numbers $z$ such that $|z+1|\le|z-1|$ is the half plane

options.A: of complex numbers that lie above the real axis;
options.B: of complex numbers that lie below the real axis;
options.C: of complex numbers that lie left of the imaginary axis;
options.D: of complex numbers that lie right of the imaginary axis.
